title: Carnival Snowballs: no more flash in the park
kaylee: The horse and carriage stays up on the cliff road instead of flashing into the middle of the park for a moment (the fox too).

pictures.title: The moment the carriage sets off
pictures.caption: Before: for a frame it pops up on top of the snowman. After: it starts at the far end of the cliff road, out of sight.
